facts.P1_fx_receipts: Yes, but converting over USD 50,000 a year needs documents.
facts.P2_fcy_account: Yes: banks offer foreign-currency savings accounts; the conversion quota applies.
facts.P3_local_gateways: Domestic sales run on Alipay and WeChat Pay; not researched yet.
facts.L1_registration: Register an individual household business; tiny online sellers under RMB 100,000 may be exempt.
facts.L2_tax_id: Entities use the Uniform Social Credit Code; individuals' number not confirmed yet.
facts.L3_income_tax_foreign: Worldwide income taxed; freelance fees 3–45%, business income 5–35%.
facts.L4_vat_gst: Small-scale VAT 1% until 2027; exempt up to RMB 100,000 a month.
facts.L5_data_protection: PIPL since 2021; fines up to RMB 50 million or 5% of revenue.
facts.L6_consumer_ecommerce: Online buyers can return goods within 7 days without reason.
facts.L7_incentives: Small-scale VAT relief: 1% rate and a monthly exemption.

watch_out.text: Over USD 50,000 a year, you need contracts to convert foreign income.
Foreigners can't register an individual household business.
